publicrecords.description: Public Records hosted MCP tools on Apify: detect a website's tech stack, validate and format phone numbers to E.164 with country and line type (not a live carrier lookup), search Wikipedia or fetch ECB FX and U.S. Treasury yields, look up Crossref papers and DOIs, and run bulk DNS / SPF / DMARC checks. Connect with your own Apify account (OAuth, or set APIFY_TOKEN). Catalog: https://github.com/GeminiGeorge22/publicrecords-mcp — Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords
